skill_name: Generate a persuasive argument for new initiatives in animal welfare legislation.
workflow: As the human population continues to grow, it is important to have laws in place to protect animal welfare. Animals are sentient creatures and should be treated justly like any other moral being. They also provide vital ecological services to the planet. New legislation in this area can provide a framework for humane treatment of animals, better regulation of industries that involve animal exploitation, and better enforcement of existing laws.
